`texture.unity3d` is a synthetic, uncompressed UnityFS bundle containing a
2×2 RGBA32 Texture2D and a separate `test.resS` stream. Its bottom row is blue
and half-transparent white; its top row is red and green. It contains no game
assets.

`texture.assets` contains the same texture with inline pixels, and
`no-texture.assets` is an empty serialized asset file.
